prompts.source: problems_v1 nr200_ssd golden brief (rows 37-38), resolved facts embedded
prompts.prompt: Design a single-piece printable mounting bracket for one 2.5-inch SSD (the drive is 69.85 mm wide x 100.2 mm long x 9.5 mm thick): a flat base plate 110 x 80 x 4 mm that bolts to a case floor rail with two M4 clearance holes (4.4 mm) spaced 60 mm apart along the base centerline; two side rails 3 mm thick that cradle the drive width with 0.4 mm clearance per side; four M3 clearance holes (3.4 mm) through the side rails matching the SSD side-mount pattern, two per side spaced 61.7 mm apart along the length, centered 6.35 mm above the drive seating surface. Leave the connector end fully open. All walls at least 2 mm thick.

prompts.source: problems_v1 nr200_hdd35 golden brief (rows 37-38), resolved facts embedded
prompts.prompt: Design a single-piece printable tray bracket that mounts one 3.5-inch hard drive (101.6 mm wide x 147.0 mm long x 26.1 mm tall) to a case bottom rail: base plate 160 x 115 x 4 mm with four M5 clearance holes (5.4 mm) at the corners of a 130 x 90 mm rectangle; two side walls 3 mm thick and 30 mm tall that cradle the drive width with 0.5 mm clearance per side; four 4.0 mm clearance holes through the side walls for the drive's side screws, two per side spaced 76.2 mm apart along the length, centered 10 mm above the base top surface. Leave the connector end fully open.

prompts.source: problems_v1 meshify_duct golden brief (rows 37-38, 47) with the printable-envelope constraint W1 exposed (the 334 mm duct exceeded a 250 mm bed)
prompts.prompt: Design a single-piece printable air duct that mounts on a 120 mm case fan and turns its airflow 90 degrees: square inlet flange 120 x 120 x 4 mm with four M4 clearance holes (4.4 mm) on the standard 105 x 105 mm fan bolt pattern; duct walls 2.4 mm thick; smooth internal transition to a rectangular outlet 100 x 40 mm. The whole duct must fit within a 240 x 240 x 200 mm printer build volume, and the run along the airflow direction must be at most 200 mm.

prompts.source: arbitrary_v1 bracket_pipe_clamp_single (residual fail, row 33), prompt + expect verbatim
prompts.prompt: Design a single-piece pipe clamp bracket for a 25 mm OD pipe: semi-circular saddle 13 mm inner radius x 20 mm wide, two M5 bolt ears each 30 x 15 x 5 mm extending from the saddle ends, M5 clearance hole centered in each ear. Flat back face 60 x 20 mm with two M4 clearance holes 20 mm apart for wall mounting.

prompts.source: arbitrary_v1 organizer_pen_cup_hex (residual fail, row 33), prompt + expect verbatim
prompts.prompt: Design a single-piece hexagonal pen cup organizer: regular hexagon outer across-flats 70 mm, height 100 mm, wall thickness 3 mm, open top, flat bottom 3 mm thick, six equally-spaced 10 mm diameter circular drain holes on the bottom face.
Design a single-piece flat mounting plate: 100 mm long x 60 mm wide x 6 mm thick; a 12 mm central drive bore through the plate; 4 M5 clearance holes (5.4 mm) on a 40 mm bolt circle.
Design a single-piece linkage bar: 120 mm long x 24 mm wide x 8 mm thick; a 10 mm pivot bore through each end, 100 mm apart; 3 M4 clearance holes (4.4 mm) along the centre line for lightening.
Design a single-piece pillow block: 80 mm long x 40 mm wide x 30 mm tall; a 22 mm bearing bore through the length; 4 M6 clearance holes (6.6 mm) through the base.

prompts.source: fresh, distinct-diameter hole-group class (row 39 assignment-pool lesson)

prompts.source: fresh, thin-wall tray with vents + standoffs (rows 37-38 tray class)
